title: parallel-plan
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

hash.description: Hash of the plan, which is also an event

workers.description: Worker count in force (default 2; the ceiling is `loop.parallel.workersMax`, default 4)

phases.description: Per phase: its groups, its serial tasks, and the ceiling of the speed-up under equal task cost

groups.description: Per group: ordinal, and the task ids in the order of the tasks at launch. A group holds at least 2 and at most `workers` tasks, all consecutive and admitted

tasks.description: Per candidate task: id, write scope (path prefixes relative to the workspace root), the source of the scope (consumer declaration, or the task's own text at launch), and the verdict of every admission check with its detail

serial.description: Tasks made serial, each with the reason

fallback.description: When the layer is off for the run: the reason, from the closed set of fallback reasons
fallback.x-type-in-words: Member of a closed set, or null
